newsitem.title: CHINA: WTO chief predicts tough time ahead on China entry.
newsitem.headline: WTO chief predicts tough time ahead on China entry.

text.p: World Trade Organisation (WTO) Director General Renato Ruggiero on Wednesday predicted a tough time ahead in negotiations over China's entry to the global trade club.
"We are approaching now the final stage of the negotiations, and just because of that it will be a tough time," Ruggiero told a news conference in Beijing.

Ruggerio said he was trying to inject a sense of urgency and flexibility into the talks for China's long-delayed accession to the WTO. "Before the end of the spring, the Chinese side has to present an ambitious offer on market access," Ruggiero said.

Diplomats from countries involved in China's crucial bilateral talks on WTO entry said they had seen little change in recent weeks in China's position on fundamental issues holding up its admission despite progress made in talks in March.
But Ruggiero, who is not involved in China's entry talks since these take place in bilateral meetings and with members en bloc, said there was no basic opposition to Beijing's accession.
"No one is opposed to China entering, providing there will be a right balance of interests," he said.
